messages:
Marta (Docs): Hey team — PR #8422 is ready for review. Netlify preview link is up but a bunch of images are 404 in the preview.
Sahil (DevEx): I saw that earlier. Locally images render fine with `mkdocs serve`. Netlify's HTML has different absolute paths.
Marta (Docs): Locally I'm seeing `/docs/assets/img/logo.png` and Netlify serves `/assets/img/logo.png`. Not sure which part of the pipeline is stripping the `docs/` prefix.
Netlify Bot: Build #987654321 for deploy-preview 8422 finished with errors: 404 GET /assets/img/logo.png — https://app.netlify.com/sites/redwood-docs/deploys/987654321
Lee (Eng): This smells like `site_dir` vs `site_url` mismatch in mkdocs.yml or the netlify.toml publish dir. Can someone paste the netlify.toml?
Sahil (DevEx): netlify.toml uses `publish = "site"` and `build.command = "mkdocs build -f mkdocs.yml"`. mkdocs.yml has `site_dir: site` and `use_directory_urls: true`.
Marta (Docs): Quick experiment: I toggled `use_directory_urls: false` locally and rebuilt — that normalized paths to `/assets/img/...` and matched Netlify.
Lee (Eng): Ok — two options: change mkdocs config to match Netlify expectations, or adjust Netlify publish dir to include the `docs` prefix. The former is less infra-invasive.
Sahil (DevEx): For previews we prefer touching docs config. I pushed a tiny patch to rewrite image paths and added a migration note in `docs/migration-guide.md`. Also updated `mkdocs.yml` to set `site_url` and `use_directory_urls: false`.
Marta (Docs): PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8422 — please review. Can we try to merge in the afternoon window (after 17:00 PT) to avoid the nightly cron where linkcheck tends to flap?
Lee (Eng): I'll review in ~30m. @Sahil can you trigger a Netlify re-deploy after the config change so we can confirm preview artifacts are fixed?
Sahil (DevEx): Yep. Command I use for a manual preview deploy: `ntl deploy --dir=site --message "preview fix"` — but Netlify previews use the automated PR hook.
Docs Preview Bot: Preview URL created: https://deploy-preview-8422--redwood-docs.netlify.app
Marta (Docs): On my side the preview shows images now. Thanks. I also added a short note in the PR about how to reproduce locally.
Lee (Eng): LGTM. One tiny nit about a code block formatting in `examples/sdk-snippet.md`. Approving after that change. :+1:
Sahil (DevEx): Rebuilt the preview, Netlify Bot reports success: Deploy #987654322 — https://deploy-preview-8422--redwood-docs.netlify.app (200)
Marta (Docs): Great — merging in 10 minutes. I'll monitor staging and trigger a full staging rebuild after merge.
Netlify Bot: Staging rebuild queued for branch `main`.
Marta (Docs): Repro instructions I left in the PR: `git fetch origin pull/8422/head:pr/8422 && git checkout pr/8422 && pip install -r requirements.txt && mkdocs serve -a 0.0.0.0:8000` — opens at http://localhost:8000. Also note: if linkcheck is flapping, run `mkdocs build` locally with `LINKCHECK_SKIP=true` to skip that step during quick checks.
Sahil (DevEx): Quick CI tip: run `CI=true make docs-build` when you want the same env as the pipeline — nginx-style path rewrites aren't present locally unless you build with `mkdocs build` (not `mkdocs serve`).
Marta (Docs): Thanks all. If anything weird pops up post-merge ping here and I'll roll back or patch immediately. :pray:
